extracted.name: Slow Cooker Cranberry Roast
extracted.description: Beef chuck cooks in a sauce of onion soup mix and cranberry sauce in this easy cranberry pot roast recipe. Serve with mashed potatoes.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1 ounce) envelope dry onion soup mix
instruction_lines: Add onion soup mix to bottom of a slow cooker, then add roast; top with cranberry sauce.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours.
Transfer roast to a cutting board; set aside. Adjust the slow cooker to High.
Whisk butter and flour together in a bowl; slowly whisk into cooking liquid in slow cooker. Serve gravy with roast.
